name: Shadow Puppet Mountain Range
description: Mountains that are actually giant shadow puppets cast by unseen hands behind a celestial screen — their profiles shift between animals, humans, and abstract forms as the 'performance' continues eternally.
prompt: Massive mountain range revealed as giant shadow puppets on celestial screen, silhouettes shifting fluidly — eagle becomes wolf becomes sleeping child becomes tree becomes dancer — unseen celestial hands articulate the forms, light source from behind creates crisp shadows with penumbra gradients, starry sky backdrop, performance has lasted millennia, sense of ancient storytelling, mystical atmosphere, 8k, wide panoramic showing endless shifting silhouettes
caption:
The mountains are not rock. They're stories — acted out in light and shadow. 🏔️👁️

Watch long enough. You'll see yourself in the silhouette.
